item.title: Join Us!
item.description: WUSM FM-88.5 is a non-commercial radio station offering USM students hands on and “on-the-air” experience in the exciting field of radio broadcasting. All WUSM programming can be heard online at southermissradio.com. Practicums and volunteer positions are available for students of the University of Southern Mississippi through the school of Journalism and Mass Communications. item.title: What is Southern Miss Radio?
item.description: Southern Miss Radio is dedicated to playing the best new alternative/modern music available. Alternative pop, rock, hip hop, and other music in the cracks is well-represented here. Southern Miss Radio provides listeners an alternative to traditional commercial radio by providing access to local, regional, national and international artists marching to a different beat.
